research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: True Anomaly is engaged in research and development of modular spacecraft bus systems, as described in 'Modular spacecraft bus system and associated methods.' The abstract details a spacecraft bus system comprising a propulsion assembly, top plate assembly, and bottom plate assembly, each designed for separate assembly and spaceworthiness testing. This work highlights True Anomaly’s focus on modular spacecraft architecture to support space security and resilience.

overview_description.description: True Anomaly develops space security technologies, including spacecraft, software platforms, and mission systems for orbital operations. The company builds satellites and autonomous systems that support monitoring, maneuvering, and coordination in space environments. Its offerings include simulation tools and mission planning software that help operators model scenarios and manage on-orbit activities. The organization also provides hardware and integrated systems that enable responsive deployment and control of space assets. Its work focuses on supporting government and commercial missions that require situational awareness and operational capabilities beyond Earth.

about_short_description.short_description: True Anomaly develops space security technologies, including spacecraft, software platforms, and mission systems for orbital operations.

product.name: Mosaic
product.description: A mission autonomy and command-and-control software platform for planning, simulating, commanding, and monitoring space superiority missions across spacecraft and multi-domain forces.

product.name: Jackal
product.description: An autonomous orbital vehicle for space superiority missions, providing high-maneuverability spacecraft, modular payload hosting, multispectral sensing, and rendezvous and proximity operations across multiple orbits.

product.name: Advanced Payloads
product.description: A suite of modular space payloads supporting multiple sensing modalities for space domain awareness, reconnaissance, tracking, imaging, and other space superiority missions.

product.name: Space-Based Interceptors
product.description: Space-based interceptor systems intended to provide government customers with capabilities for responding to and countering threats in orbit.

product.name: Digital and On-Orbit Range Solutions
product.description: Training and test capabilities that combine digital mission environments with live spacecraft and payloads to develop and evaluate space tactics, techniques, procedures, and operator readiness.
